# package store

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/store"
```

Package store is the optional persistence of go-profinet: the values a device must keep across a restart (its permanent station name and IP suite, its I&M records) are saved in a [Store](#type-store) under a key.

Two backends come with it: [Memory](#type-memory), for tests and for applications that persist elsewhere, and [Dir](#type-dir), a directory of files whose updates are atomic and checked on load. A library user needs neither a filesystem nor this package: a device without a store keeps its state in memory, as before.

A Store holds opaque values; their format is the caller's. Keys are short names of lowercase letters, digits, '.', '\_' and '-' ([ValidKey](#func-validkey)).

## Variables

```go
var (
	// ErrNotFound reports a key with no value.
	ErrNotFound = fmt.Errorf("store: %w", profinet.ErrNotFound)
	// ErrCorrupt reports a value that failed its integrity check and has
	// no intact previous version to fall back on.
	ErrCorrupt = fmt.Errorf("store: corrupt value: %w", profinet.ErrMalformed)
)
```

Errors of a Store. ErrNotFound and ErrCorrupt match profinet.ErrNotFound and profinet.ErrMalformed with errors.Is.

## Functions

### func ValidKey

```go
func ValidKey(key string) error
```

ValidKey reports whether key can name a value: 1 to MaxKeyLen characters of a-z, 0-9, '.', '\_' and '-', not starting with '.'.

## Types

### type Dir

```go
type Dir struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Dir is a Store in a directory: the value of key is the file key.v, its previous version key.v.prev. Save writes a temporary file, syncs it, renames the current file to the previous one and the temporary file to the current one, then syncs the directory; Load checks a file's header and CRC-32C and falls back on the previous version when the current one is corrupt or missing (a crash between the two renames). A Dir assumes it is the only writer of its directory.

#### func OpenDir

```go
func OpenDir(path string, opts DirOptions) (*Dir, error)
```

OpenDir opens (and creates, with mode 0o700) the directory of a Dir. It removes the temporary files an interrupted Save left.

### type DirOptions

```go
type DirOptions struct {
	// MaxValueSize bounds a value; zero means DefaultMaxValueSize.
	MaxValueSize int
	// NoSync skips the fsync calls (faster, for tests): an update is then
	// atomic against a crash of the program but not of the machine.
	NoSync bool
	// OnRecover is called when Load found a value corrupt or missing and
	// returned the previous version instead; cause says why. It must not
	// block.
	OnRecover func(key string, cause error)
}
```

DirOptions configure a [Dir](#type-dir).

### type Store

```go
type Store interface {
	// Load returns the value of key, ErrNotFound when it has none.
	Load(ctx context.Context, key string) ([]byte, error)
	// Save replaces the value of key atomically: after a failure or a
	// crash, Load returns the old value or the new one, never a mix.
	Save(ctx context.Context, key string, value []byte) error
	// Delete removes key; a key without a value is not an error.
	Delete(ctx context.Context, key string) error
}
```

Store keeps values under keys. Its methods are safe for concurrent use.
